faq.label: Before we begin
faq.title: Six questions we are asked most.

items.title: How long does a website take?
items.text: A focused landing page typically takes two to three weeks. A five-page site is usually three to five weeks after content and scope are agreed. These are sample timelines, not a delivery guarantee.

items.title: What do you need from us?
items.text: Your goals, existing brand assets, and a first draft of your content. We start with a short brief and identify any gaps before design begins.

items.title: Can you improve our existing website?
items.text: Yes. We can start with a speed and content review, then recommend a focused update or a rebuild based on what we find.

items.title: Will we be able to edit the site?
items.text: Content is stored in plain text and structured data files. This sample project has no CMS; an editing workflow would be agreed before a real build.

items.title: What happens after launch?
items.text: You receive the site source and a handover guide. Hosting, maintenance, and future updates are separately scoped so responsibilities stay clear.

items.title: Do you guarantee a perfect speed score?
items.text: No. We build against a small performance budget and test the result. The hosting environment, content, and later changes can affect scores.

process-detail.label: How it works
process-detail.title: The same four steps, in more detail.
process-detail.intro: Every project runs through the same sequence, whatever its size.

items.title: Brief
items.text: We agree on your audience, pages, content, and the one action your website needs to support. You get a written scope before design starts.

items.title: Design
items.text: We establish the visual direction and review the core page layouts with you before any template is written.

items.title: Build
items.text: We build reusable components, optimize every asset against a page-weight budget, and check mobile layouts and keyboard access as we go.

items.title: Launch
items.text: After your approval we verify the forms and the speed scores on the real host, then hand over the source and a short guide.

faq-pricing.label: Payment and timing
faq-pricing.title: How the money and the calendar work.

items.title: When would payment be due?
items.text: A sample arrangement is 50% to begin and 50% at handover. Any real payment terms would be confirmed in a written proposal.

items.title: When does the timeline start?
items.text: After scope, content, and the initial payment are agreed. Feedback delays or additional pages can change the schedule.

items.title: What costs are separate?
items.text: Domain registration, hosting, ongoing care, and new work outside the agreed scope. We would list each separately before you proceed.
